root.title: Dower
root.sub: a debt due to the wife (Quran 4:4)

children.title: Proper (mahr-ul-misl)
children.sub: by her father's family and her qualities

root: How a Muslim marriage is dissolved
rootSub: the MFLO s. 7 / s. 8 procedure applies to every mode except death

title: Talaq under section 7 of the MFLO

steps.title: Pronouncement
steps.text: Talaq in any form — oral, written, single or triple

steps.title: Notice to the Chairman + copy to the wife
steps.text: As soon as may be; failure — up to 1 year or Rs. 5,000

steps.title: Arbitration Council
steps.text: Constituted within 30 days to attempt reconciliation

steps.title: 90 days (or end of pregnancy, if later)
steps.text: Talaq may be revoked, expressly or by conduct, in this period

steps.title: Talaq effective
steps.text: Certificate of effectiveness; remarriage of the same parties without halala unless third termination

title: Dissolution of Muslim Marriages Act 1939 — section 2 grounds

cards.title: (i) Missing 4 years
cards.text: Notice to heirs, uncle, brother (s. 3); decree suspended 6 months

cards.title: (iia) MFLO polygamy
cards.text: Additional wife without Arbitration Council permission

cards.title: (iii) Prison 7 years
cards.text: Only after the sentence is final

cards.title: (v) Impotence
cards.text: At marriage and continuing; one year to cure

cards.title: (vi) Insanity / leprosy / VD
cards.text: Insane for 2 years, or leprosy or virulent venereal disease

cards.title: (vii) Option of puberty
cards.text: Married before 16, repudiated before 18, not consummated

cards.title: (viia) Lian
cards.text: Husband accuses wife of zina; she denies (2006)

cards.title: (viii) Cruelty
cards.text: Assault or misery, evil company, immoral life, property, religion, inequitable treatment

cards.title: (ix) Any other Muslim-law ground
cards.text: Basis of khula decrees (Balqis Fatima; Khurshid Bibi)

cards.title: ss. 4–5
cards.text: Apostasy does not dissolve by itself; dower preserved

root: Guardianship and custody of a minor
rootSub: the welfare of the minor is the paramount consideration (GWA s. 17)

children.title: Of marriage
children.text: Father, grandfather, agnates, mother, State; option of puberty

children.title: Of the person
children.text: Father (natural guardian); s. 19(b) — no other guardian while a fit father lives

children.title: Of property
children.text: Father, his executor, paternal grandfather, his executor, court; s. 29 limits

children.title: Custody (hizanat)
children.text: Mother — boy till 7, girl till puberty (Hanafi); then other females; then father

title: A suit in the Family Court

steps.title: Plaint with list of witnesses and précis
steps.text: Filed where the wife ordinarily resides (dissolution, dower, maintenance)

steps.title: Summons and written statement
steps.text: Husband may claim restitution in his written statement

steps.title: Pre-trial hearing — reconciliation
steps.text: Khula suit: if reconciliation fails, decree forthwith; restore haq mehr received

steps.title: Issues and evidence
steps.text: Interim maintenance by the 14th of each month in maintenance suits

steps.title: Second reconciliation; judgment within 6 months
steps.text: CPC and QSO excluded except ss. 10–11 CPC

steps.title: Decree, copy to Chairman, appeal
steps.text: Dissolution effective 90 days after copy sent; appeal in 30 days with exceptions
